features.behavior: CSS.supports(property, value) and CSS.supports('(prop: value)') parse through ve-style. Compound not/and/or queries are evaluated. Unknown, invalid, and deferred properties return false.
features.diagnostic: capability_unsupported is not used; feature detection is false.

features.behavior: min/max-width/height px, orientation, prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-color-scheme, compound `and` queries against innerWidth/innerHeight. addListener/change dispatch.
features.gaps: resolution/DPR queries, live viewportchange without dispatchEvent.

features.behavior: Async fetchStart/fetchPoll. Poll does not complete the body; settle completes one in-flight fetch per slice. text/json/arrayBuffer/blob, bodyUsed, clone of unused body, AbortController, ReadableStream view of a finished body, bytes via bodyB64. Script-initiated CORS is denied without Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
features.gaps: Streaming backpressure against a slow consumer, HTTP/2 push.

features.behavior: Resolves when define() runs; does not resolve early for missing names.
observe/disconnect/takeRecords via the mutation journal. childList target is the parent. attributes honor attributeFilter and attributeOldValue. characterData honors characterDataOldValue.
RFC 6455 handshake, masked send, close, ping/pong, fragmented data frames, TLS and plaintext poll. open/message/error/close listeners. readyState 0/1/3.

open/put/get/delete origin-partitioned stores, createIndex (unique + compound key paths), index.get, IDBCursor, versionchange only when the version increases, IDBTransaction.abort restores the store snapshot. Dedicated Worker postMessage evaluates in a second V8 isolate (`typeof document` is undefined).
features.gaps: quota, Worker importScripts after the worker has started (startup importScripts and abort are implemented).

features.behavior: register() yields an activated intercept. One V8 isolate per registration persists across fetches (self state is kept). install/activate and fetch run on that thread. Boot importScripts expand from a URL map. clients.claim() during activate sets navigator.serviceWorker.controller. A changed second register() sits in waiting until self.skipWaiting() promotes it. clients.matchAll() returns controlled window clients; {includeUncontrolled:true} includes same-origin clients. respondWith(new Response), Response.redirect, and event.request.url/method are visible to the fetch listener. describe() reports serviceWorkers:true.
features.gaps: Client.postMessage beyond skipWaiting; dedicated/shared worker clients.

features.behavior: getContext('webgl'|'webgpu') returns null. describe() reports webgl:false and webgpu:false. Explicit compatibility track, not a hidden omission.
HTMLCanvasElement.toDataURL encodes the software backing store as a PNG data URL.
Alt-Svc parser only. describe() reports http3:false.
Returns a live NodeList (Symbol.toStringTag NodeList) of elements whose name attribute matches. Not an HTMLCollection.
features.gaps: window named properties for every id beyond the document getter.

features.behavior: document.embeds and document.plugins are the same cached HTMLCollection instance (embeds === embeds === plugins).
features.gaps: named-item lookup on that collection for every embed/object shape.

features.behavior: DOMStringMap on HTMLElement/SVGElement/MathMLElement. Camel-case data-* mapping. Invalid names (leading hyphen-digit, constructor/toString fallthrough) are undefined; space-only set throws InvalidCharacterError.
features.gaps: non-ASCII name edge cases beyond the official dataset tests already passing.

features.behavior: innerText getter is layout/style-aware (skips display:none, br→newline, block breaks; detached/not-rendered falls back to textContent). Setter replaces children, turning newlines into br (null→empty, undefined stringifies). outerText getter equals innerText; setter replaces the node and merges adjacent text; detached throws NoModificationAllowedError.
features.gaps: dir=auto leftover is a global-attributes issue, not this family.

features.behavior: Live HTML named properties on Document: embed/form/iframe/img/object by name; object also by id; img by id only when it also has a name. Single iframe returns contentWindow; multiple matches return a cached live HTMLCollection. Not shadowed by prototype properties.
features.gaps: none in the official nameditem-*.html family.

features.behavior: ARIAMixin string reflection for non-enumerated attributes (role and remaining aria* IDL ↔ content, null/undefined removes). Enumerated ARIA IDL attributes use keyword maps (case-insensitive canonicalization, empty/invalid defaults). Missing attributes still return null so aria-attribute-reflection.html stays PASS. Element-reflection FrozenArrays resolve in-scope ids.
features.gaps: aria-attribute-reflection-enumerated.tentative.html missing-value defaults that are not null (ariaBusy→false, etc.) stay FAIL so the string mixin nullability tests remain PASS.

features.behavior: Node.prepend inserts nodes/strings at the start of childNodes. Node.baseURI returns the document URL.
features.gaps: DocumentFragment.prepend host-context cases not in the supported subset.

features.behavior: HTML `<?start|marker|end?>` comments become ProcessingInstruction nodes. `<template for>` patches a named range or, when `for` is empty, inserts in place. `buffer` is a boolean IDL attribute and freezes the first-seen `for`/`buffer`/`sanitize`/`src`. `sanitize` / `sanitize="sanitize"` strips scripts; other values run them. `streamAppendHTMLUnsafe()` applies streamed `<template for>` patches. `src` fetches asynchronously and does not block the parser.
features.gaps: chunked progressive src rendering depends on trickle resources; empty `for=""` is treated as in-place (same DOM as boolean `for`).
